about: Concert pitch stored, written pitch and MIDI derived, for a B-flat clarinet and an octave-transposing bass (G01 §7.2, A19).
spec: G01 §7.2: the graph stores the concert spelling; written = concert moved back by the transposition (diatonic -(d + 7 octave), chromatic -(c + 12 octave)); MIDI = 12 (oct + 1) + pc + alter. The printed key of a transposing part is derived: written fifths = concert fifths - (7c - 12d).
